name: 2022-23 Regular - ICT-2154  Digital Systems
subject: Digital Systems

questions.markdown: Design a combinational circuit to perform $F = A - B$ when control input $Y=0$ and perform $F = 1 + 2A - B$ when control input $Y=1$ using 4-bit parallel binary adders and minimum universal gates. Assume $A$, $B$ and $F$ are 4-bit binary numbers.
Design an asynchronous Down counter to count from 5 to 2 using positive edge triggered D flip flops and minimum external gates.
Design T flip flop using NAND latch and external gates.

Design a sequence detector using Mealy model with one input $Y$ and one output $Z$. The output $Z$ is HIGH whenever the sequence "1001" is detected, otherwise the output is LOW. Overlapping of the sequence is allowed. Implement using JK flip flops and minimum number of external gates.

Realize the Boolean functions:

$$
F_1(A,B,C)=\Sigma_m(0,1,2,5) \quad \text{and} \quad F_2(A,B,C)=\Pi_M(1,5,6)
$$
Design a combinational circuit that compares two, 4-bit numbers to check if they are equal using logic gates. The circuit output is equal to 1, if the two numbers are equal and 0 otherwise.
Design a code converter to convert a decimal digit represented in 8 4 -2 -1 code to a decimal digit represented in gray code using 3:8 decoders and minimum external gates.
Design a 16:1 MUX using 2:1 MUXs ONLY.
Using asynchronous hexadecimal counter ICs and external gates, design a 2-digit hexadecimal counter which counts from 00 to 89H and repeats.

Minimize the following using Quine McCluskey Method and realize using basic gates.

$$
F(A,B,C,D)=\Sigma m(4,5,6,8,10,13)
$$
Design sequence generator using johnson counter (shift register) to generate sequence 1101.
Design a 4 x 16 decoder using only 3 x 8 decoders.
Design and implement a MOD-5 synchronous counter using JK flip-flops and draw its timing diagram.
Design a 2X2 bit combinational multiplier using basic gates.

Solve the POS function minimization of 5 variable K-Map using the following expression: 

$$
\pi M(0,2,4,7,8,10,12,16,18,20,23,24,25,26,27,28).
$$
